# RewardsPro loyalty platform

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/rewardspro)

Loyalty tiers, credit, points and reward records, with Shopify integration and merchant-facing administration.

**Scope:** Existing platform; new paid subscriptions and paid plan changes are retired. Existing agreements retain their records and support paths.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `rewardspro`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Remix routes, services, repositories, Shopify extensions and a separate public landing site are present. Connector separation is documented as ongoing; it is not parity with the new API foundation.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Use the app architecture and navigation registries before editing services; keep existing agreements and the documented connector boundaries intact.
